## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Hive Scale
where: ScaleRepository (uses), src/persistence/repositories.ts, component persistence

=====SOURCE-BEGIN
private readonly items = new Map<string, ScaleRecord>();
=====SOURCE-END=====

### B

=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: A and B are different concepts. A is a hive scale, a weighing device. ScaleRepository stores ScaleRecord entries (`private readonly items = new Map<string, ScaleRecord>();`). ScaleService uses it through linkScale, recordReading and sendAlert, which fits a device that is linked to something, takes readings and sends alerts. B is the hive itself. ReportService loops over HiveRepository.findAll (`for (const hive of this.hives.findAll())`) and looks up harvests and treatments for each hive. A scale may be attached to a hive, but it is a separate real-world thing with its own repository and service, so the two are related, not the same concept.
